title: Response tokens survive consistency changes
requirement: An eligible response session token is captured independently of the operation's effective consistency, and a later Session operation automatically resolves and enforces that token.

hostedEmulatorGatewayV1.reason: Replication pause makes the later Session read prove that the earlier Eventual response populated the automatic token cache.

hostedEmulatorGatewayV2.reason: Replication pause makes the later Session read prove that the earlier Eventual response populated the automatic token cache.

azureLive.reason: A deterministic stale-replica read requires hosted-emulator replication control.
